pages.text: A swallow nest clung beneath the barn ceiling. Chirp, chirp, chirp came from inside.
Lulu stood on tiptoe. "I want to see a baby swallow's face."
Uncle Nino cleared his throat. "Call birds, and they come out. My bird calls were the best in my day."
He cupped his hands. Peep, peep! The nest fell silent.
A louder peeeeep! The mother swallow flew over and circled his head.
Peck! She struck his hat. "Oh!" He covered his head.
The nest was quiet as a tightly shut mouth.
Lulu sat in a corner, very still and quiet. The barn fell silent.
Peek! A yellow beak appeared. A baby swallow looked down at Lulu.
Lulu and the baby watched each other a long time. Uncle Nino peered through the door crack, gripping his hat.
